conventions.tokens: Scored words in reading order. Punctuation is stripped and is never a token. English keeps its printed case.
conventions.needs_line: 1-based sentence number (see story.lines) holding the main answer evidence; ask the question only if the child read at least that far.
conventions.vowel_marks: none — as in the May 2026 passages; made-up words use only long-vowel letters (ا و ی ے) so they are decodable without marks.
conventions.digits: Maths items printed on the card use Western digits, as in ICT maths textbooks. Urdu prose the coach reads aloud (maths.oral.word_problems[].prompt_ur) uses Urdu digits; the v1 strip word problem keeps Western digits.
conventions.script: v2: <block>.script (maths: maths.oral.script) holds the exact words the coach says to the child. Cue lines equal a cue phrase (start ends with one), so the window finder keys on them.
conventions.oral_maths: v2: maths.oral is the May 2026 EGMA set (Form A = Set A, this term) or a parallel set (Form B = Set B, next term; equated: false). Compare A-D and sums 1-4 are printed on the card; the coach reads the word problems aloud.
conventions.status: AI-vetted. Pending sign-off by Sabeena and Sameer (decision D3).

story.title: دریا کی سیر
story.text: آج بلال اپنے والد کے ساتھ دریائے جہلم کے کنارے گیا۔ وہاں ٹھنڈی ہوا چل رہی تھی اور پانی آہستہ بہہ رہا تھا۔ بلال نے کشتی کو حرکت کرتے دیکھا۔ اس کے والد نے اسے بتایا کہ دریا ہمارے ملک کے لیے اہم ہیں۔ واپسی پر بلال نے خوبصورت پتھر جمع کیے اور مسکراتا رہا۔ وہ بہت خوش بھی تھا۔

questions.prompt: بلال کس کے ساتھ دریائے جہلم گیا؟
questions.rubric: Correct if the child says Bilal went with his father (والد / ابو / ابا / باپ).

questions.prompt: بلال نے کس چیز کو حرکت کرتے دیکھا؟
questions.rubric: Correct only if the child says a boat (کشتی).

questions.prompt: بلال خوش کیوں تھا؟
accept: پتھر جمع کرنے کی وجہ سے
والد کے ساتھ دریا پر گیا تھا
questions.rubric: Correct if the reason comes from the story: the trip to the river with his father, the cool breeze, seeing the river or the boat, or collecting beautiful stones. A circular answer ("because he was happy / smiling") is wrong. Evidence is spread over lines 1-5; needs_line marks the stones (line 5).

story.title: Planting Trees
story.text: Imran woke up early for school. Today his class was planting trees. He took a small plant in a bag. The teacher asked Imran to show the class how to plant it. Imran dug a hole, put the plant in the soil and put water in it slowly. The teacher was happy with his work. His friends clapped for him.

questions.prompt: What was the class planting?
questions.rubric: Correct if the child says trees or plants. An answer in Urdu or English is accepted.

questions.prompt: What did Imran take in a bag?
questions.rubric: Correct if the child says a plant or a small plant (a small or baby tree is the same thing). Just "tree" / درخت repeats question 1 and is not enough. Books, food, water, seeds or soil are wrong. An answer in Urdu or English is accepted.

questions.prompt: Why was the teacher happy with Imran?
accept: he showed the class how to plant it
he put water in the plant
اس نے کلاس کو پودا لگانا سکھایا
he put the plant in the soil
اس نے اچھی طرح پودا لگایا
اس نے پودا مٹی میں لگایا
questions.rubric: Correct if the child gives any reason linked to Imran's planting work: he did good work, planted it well, showed the class how, or names a step he did (dug a hole, put the plant in the soil, watered it). Bringing a plant, or waking early, is wrong. An answer in Urdu or English is accepted.

story.title: بازار کی سیر
story.text: اتوار کو زینب اپنی والدہ کے ساتھ بازار گئی۔ وہاں بہت سی دکانیں تھیں اور لوگ خریداری کر رہے تھے۔ زینب نے پھلوں کی دکان سے سرخ سیب خریدے۔ اس کی والدہ نے بتایا کہ پھل صحت کے لیے مفید ہوتے ہیں۔ گھر پہنچ کر زینب نے سیب دھوئے اور سب کو دیے۔ دادی جان نے خوش ہو کر اسے بہت دعائیں دیں۔

questions.prompt: زینب کس کے ساتھ بازار گئی؟
questions.rubric: Correct if the child says Zainab went with her mother (والدہ / امی / ماں).

questions.prompt: زینب نے پھلوں کی دکان سے کیا خریدا؟
questions.rubric: Correct only if the child says apples (سیب); "fruit" alone is not enough.

questions.prompt: دادی جان نے زینب کو دعائیں کیوں دیں؟
accept: زینب نے سیب سب کو دیے
اس نے سیب دھو کر سب کو دیے
زینب نے دادی کو سیب دیا
اس نے سب کو پھل دیے
اس نے سب کو سیب دے کر اچھا کام کیا
questions.rubric: Correct if the child says Zainab gave or shared the apples (with or without washing them). Washing alone, a generic "she did good work", or only saying grandmother was happy, is wrong. Evidence is line 5.

story.title: Ducks in the Park
story.text: Hina got up early on Saturday. Her family was going to the park. She packed some bread and two eggs in a box for lunch. At the park, Hina saw ducks on the pond. Her little brother wanted to feed them. Hina gave him some bread to throw in the water. The ducks swam fast to eat it, and everyone laughed.

questions.prompt: Where was Hina's family going?
questions.rubric: Correct if the child says the park. An answer in Urdu or English is accepted.

questions.prompt: What did Hina pack for lunch?
questions.rubric: Correct if the child names the bread or the eggs (either one is enough). Anything else, or only "a box", is wrong. An answer in Urdu or English is accepted.

questions.prompt: Why did everyone laugh?
accept: the ducks swam fast to eat the bread
the ducks rushed to the bread
the ducks raced for the bread
بطخیں تیزی سے روٹی کھانے آئیں
questions.rubric: Correct if the answer names the ducks swimming fast or rushing for the bread (food). Also correct: the ducks came or hurried to eat the bread, or the brother threw bread and the ducks came fast (بطخیں روٹی کھانے آئیں / دوڑ کر آئیں). Wrong: "they were happy", "because of the ducks" or "the ducks ate the bread" with nothing about the ducks coming or rushing. روٹی and ڈبل روٹی both mean the bread. An answer in Urdu or English is accepted.

story.title: دریا کی سیر
story.text: آج بلال اپنے والد کے ساتھ دریائے جہلم کے کنارے گیا۔ وہاں ٹھنڈی ہوا چل رہی تھی اور پانی آہستہ بہہ رہا تھا۔ بلال نے کشتی کو حرکت کرتے دیکھا۔ اس کے والد نے اسے بتایا کہ دریا ہمارے ملک کے لیے اہم ہیں۔ واپسی پر بلال نے خوبصورت پتھر جمع کیے اور مسکراتا رہا۔ وہ بہت خوش بھی تھا۔ گھر پہنچ کر بلال نے پتھر دھو کر ایک ڈبے میں رکھ دیے۔ اگلے دن بلال نے وہ پتھر اسکول میں اپنی جماعت کو دکھائے۔ استاد نے بتایا کہ دریا کا پانی برسوں تک پتھروں کو رگڑتا رہتا ہے۔ اسی لیے پتھر گول اور چکنے ہو جاتے ہیں۔ بلال کے دوستوں نے پوچھا کہ کیا وہ بھی کبھی دریا دیکھ سکتے ہیں۔ استاد نے مسکرا کر کہا کہ اگلے مہینے پوری جماعت سیر کے لیے جائے گی۔ یہ سن کر سب بچوں نے زور زور سے تالیاں بجائیں۔ بلال نے سوچا کہ وہ اپنے والد سے دریا کے بارے میں اور باتیں پوچھے گا، تاکہ سیر کے دن وہ اپنے دوستوں کو سب کچھ بتا سکے۔

story.title: Planting Trees
story.text: Imran woke up early for school. Today his class was planting trees. He took a small plant in a bag. The teacher asked Imran to show the class how to plant it. Imran dug a hole, put the plant in the soil and put water in it slowly. The teacher was happy with his work. His friends clapped for him. After school, Imran walked home with his sister. He told her about the little tree and how he had planted it. She asked him who would water it during the holidays. Imran thought about it for a moment. Then he decided to make a list of children who could take turns to water it. The next morning, he showed the list to the teacher. She was pleased and put it up on the classroom wall. All through the holidays, two children watered the tree every week. By the end of the year, it had grown taller than Imran, and the whole class was proud of it.

questions.rubric: Correct if the child says trees or plants. Answer is in the first part (the May 2026 passage). An answer in Urdu or English is accepted.

questions.prompt: What did Imran take in a bag?
questions.rubric: Correct if the child says a plant or a small plant (a small or baby tree is the same thing). Just "tree" / درخت repeats question 1 and is not enough. Books, food, water, seeds, soil or a list are wrong. An answer in Urdu or English is accepted.

story.title: زخمی چڑیا
story.text: سردیوں کی ایک صبح حرا اسکول جانے کے لیے گھر سے نکلی۔ راستے میں اس نے سڑک کے کنارے ایک چھوٹی سی چڑیا دیکھی۔ چڑیا کا ایک پر زخمی تھا اور وہ اڑ نہیں سکتی تھی۔ حرا نے اسے آہستہ سے اپنے ہاتھوں میں اٹھایا اور گھر لے آئی۔ اس کی دادی نے ایک پرانے ڈبے میں نرم کپڑا بچھا دیا اور چڑیا کو اس میں رکھ دیا۔ حرا نے چڑیا کو پانی اور دانہ دیا اور پھر اسکول چلی گئی۔ سارا دن اسے چڑیا کی فکر رہی اور وہ سبق پر پوری توجہ نہ دے سکی۔ چھٹی کے بعد وہ دوڑتی ہوئی گھر پہنچی تو دیکھا کہ چڑیا دانہ کھا رہی تھی۔ کچھ دن تک حرا روزانہ اس کا خیال رکھتی رہی۔ ایک ہفتے بعد چڑیا ڈبے سے نکل کر کمرے میں پھدکنے لگی۔ دادی نے کہا کہ اب یہ ٹھیک ہو گئی ہے اور اسے آزاد کر دینا چاہیے۔ حرا تھوڑی اداس ہوئی، مگر اس نے کھڑکی کھول دی۔ چڑیا اڑ کر سامنے والے درخت پر جا بیٹھی اور حرا اسے دیکھ کر مسکرانے لگی۔

story.title: The Water Filter
story.text: Amna's school was having a science fair on Friday. Every class had to make something new. Amna's group chose to make a water filter from an old plastic bottle. They cut off the bottom and turned the bottle upside down. Then they filled it with small stones, sand and cotton. Next, they poured muddy water into the top. Slowly, clear water dripped out at the bottom. Her friends were very surprised. On the day of the fair, many parents came to see the work of each class. Amna explained each step in a clear voice. The head teacher asked how they got the idea. Amna said her grandma had told her that people in villages once cleaned water this way. At the end of the day, the group won second prize. Amna ran all the way home to tell her grandma. Her grandma gave her a big hug and said she was proud of the whole group. It was a happy day for them all.

questions.prompt: What old thing did Amna's group use to make the water filter?
questions.rubric: Correct if the child names the bottle (an old plastic bottle). The stones, sand or cotton are what went inside it and are not the answer to this question. An answer in Urdu or English is accepted.

questions.prompt: What did they fill the filter with?
questions.rubric: Correct if the child names at least one of the stones, the sand or the cotton. Water (muddy or clear) or mud is wrong: the muddy water was poured in afterwards. An answer in Urdu or English is accepted.

questions.prompt: How did Amna's grandma help the group win the prize?
accept: the idea came from her grandma
she told Amna how people cleaned water
she told her how villages cleaned water
